main_results.scope: Uniformly construct computable ℕ-domain structures in a fixed finite language from every computable input tree, including empty trees, with all finite-tuple orbit definitions and bidirectional path/isomorphism conversions.
Fixed oracle programs construct the structures and convert solutions uniformly, with no extendibility oracle or ordinal bound supplied as input.
This endpoint states the uniform path/isomorphism conversion of Lemma 5; the local rank and group-classification lemmas belong to the surrounding construction.
An injection-tree path is equivalent to an atomic isomorphism; this auxiliary does not establish the full degree-theoretic Corollary 7.
